subject: tr-info
title: TR.INFO.------RT.ALGN.
description: First of two diagrams in EVOL-6. The prose below identifies the structural target about preferential activity: 'Because in the final analysis, western culture has created a situation where what a person says is as significant as what a person does.' The crossing diagrams how transformation-information meets reality-alignment at the preferential-activity scale: TR-INFO crossed with RT-ALGN. POL-CY (political cycle) upper-center, (R)INTR (reality of introduction) left, TR-INFO upper-right. POST (postulation), PER-DY (perceived dynamics), AF-DY (affinity dynamics) on the right. CRT, CULT-INFO-B (cultural-information base), JR-DY (junior dynamic) center, CR-INFO-DY (creative-information dynamics) right of rt.algn. RT-ALGN center. MT-INTR (meta-introduction) lower-right, TRS (transformation) bottom-center.
